description: Hello from Egypt! 🇪🇬 We are Moon Seekers, a team of high school students participating in the Identify Earth location, Mars and the moon  challenge. We chose this because we love gaming and want to make space science fun and interactive. Our team brings skills like: soft skills, research skills, teamwork and leadership skills  to build an immersive mission game. Our roster is full, but we are thrilled to be part of NASA Space Apps and can't wait to see everyone's projects! 🚀
